# Synapse Platform

Synapse is a modern web application built with Next.js, featuring AI integration, minimal high-performance UI, and seamless accessibility.

## Purpose
This document provides LLMs with context about the structure and features of the Synapse platform.

## Features
- AI Studio Applet
- Custom dynamic routing per service
- Secure Firebase backend
- Built-in forms, analytics, and tracking

For more detailed technical documentation, please refer to the source code repository or our API specifications.
